caseName: Harrison v. Durkee Famous Foods, Inc.
caseNameFull: Harrison, Collector of Internal Revenue v. Durkee Famous Foods, Inc.
attorneys: Solicitor General Fahy for petitioner. Mr. Roger Hinds for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The petition for writ of certiorari in this case is granted. The judgment is reversed upon the authority of Colgate-Palmolive-Peet Co. v. United States, 320 U. S. 422.
